categories.main_business_segments: Tianjin Pengling Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the automotive parts manufacturing industry, focusing on the design, research and development, production, and sales of automotive fluid pipelines and automotive sealing components. The company has two main business divisions: automotive fluid pipeline products and automotive sealing parts, serving traditional fuel vehicles, hybrid vehicles, pure electric vehicles, and fuel cell vehicles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages over 30 years of experience in rubber and plastic material formulation and manufacturing processes, including advanced technologies such as nylon pipelines, TPV new materials, and integrated molding processes. It employs ERP systems and lean production methods to ensure flexible, high-quality manufacturing. The R&D centers in Tianjin and Shanghai focus on innovations in thermal management systems, sealing technologies (including zero-gap and frameless door seals), and new material applications, supported by over 300 proprietary formula technologies and more than 100 patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Pengling serves as a first-tier supplier to over 50 major domestic automotive manufacturers and powertrain companies, including BYD, Changan, FAW-Volkswagen, Great Wall Motors, Geely, SAIC Volkswagen, Chery, and emerging new energy vehicle makers like NIO, XPeng, and Li Auto. The company’s products cater to both traditional and new energy vehicle markets, with a strong focus on thermal management and sealing solutions for electric vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Tianjin, Chengdu, Taizhou, Xi'an, Hebei, Chongqing, and Jiangsu. Its sales are concentrated in key domestic regions including North China, East China, Northeast, Southwest, and Central South China, with minimal overseas sales. The company also has R&D and technical centers in Shanghai.
categories.supply_chain_position: Pengling operates in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain as a Tier 1 supplier, providing critical components such as fluid pipelines and sealing parts directly to automotive OEMs. It sources raw materials like rubber and nylon from upstream suppliers and delivers integrated component assemblies downstream to vehicle manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on transitioning from traditional fuel vehicle components to new energy vehicle technologies, emphasizing lightweight materials, thermal management modules, and advanced sealing systems. It invests heavily in R&D, with projects on nylon and TPV pipelines, high-performance turbocharger pipes, and hydrogen fuel cell vehicle components. Pengling also integrates ESG principles into governance and operations and fosters talent development and innovation to sustain competitive advantage.
categories.revenue_model: Pengling generates revenue primarily through direct sales of automotive fluid pipeline products and sealing components to OEMs under annual framework contracts. Sales are predominantly on a 'make-to-order' basis, with revenue recognized at the point of product delivery and customer acceptance. The company does not engage in subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Pengling is a leading domestic player in automotive fluid pipelines and sealing parts, consistently ranked first in the rubber hose industry by the China Rubber Industry Association. It competes with companies like Junhe Technology, Chuanhuan Technology, and Nanjing Lide Dongfang, maintaining a strong market position through technological innovation and close OEM partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Pengling achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.46 billion, a 26.08% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 77.65 million, up 173.36%. Total assets reached RMB 3.59 billion, growing 8.25%. The company has shown steady growth driven by expanding new energy vehicle market penetration and enhanced product offerings.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Pengling emphasizes its extensive proprietary technology portfolio, high-quality integrated product solutions, and strong customer intimacy as key differentiators. Its ability to provide modular, lightweight, and high-performance fluid pipeline and sealing systems tailored to new energy vehicles meets evolving OEM demands. The company’s robust R&D capabilities and flexible manufacturing processes enable rapid innovation and cost-effective production, supporting import substitution and competitive pricing.
